Configuration¶

Configuration module for the Startup Platform API.

This module handles all environment variable loading and application settings.

class Settings[source]¶

Bases: object

Application settings loaded from environment variables.

DB_HOST¶

PostgreSQL database host address.

DB_PORT¶

PostgreSQL database port.

DB_NAME¶

Name of the database.

DB_USER¶

Database username.

DB_PASSWORD¶

Database password.

SECRET_KEY¶

JWT secret key for token signing.

ALGORITHM¶

JWT algorithm (default: HS256).

ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES¶

Token expiration time in minutes.

DEBUG¶

Debug mode flag.

DB_PORT: str = '5432'¶

Authentication¶

Authentication router module.

Provides API endpoints for user registration, login, and profile retrieval.

register(user, db=fastapi.Depends)¶

Register a new user account.

Parameters:

  • user (UserCreate) – User registration data.

  • db (Session) – Database session.

Return type:

UserResponse

Returns:

Created user data.

Raises:

HTTPException – If email or username already exists.

login(user, db=fastapi.Depends)¶

Authenticate user and return access token.

Parameters:

  • user (UserLogin) – Login credentials.

  • db (Session) – Database session.

Return type:

Token

Returns:

JWT access token.

Raises:

HTTPException – If credentials are invalid.

get_current_user(token, db=fastapi.Depends)¶

Get current authenticated user’s profile.

Parameters:

  • token (str) – JWT access token.

  • db (Session) – Database session.

Return type:

UserResponse

Returns:

User profile data.

Raises:

HTTPException – If token is invalid or user not found.

Authentication utility functions.

Provides password hashing, verification, and JWT token operations.

get_password_hash(password)[source]¶

Hash a password using Argon2.

Parameters:

password (str) – Plain text password to hash.

Return type:

str

Returns:

Hashed password string.

verify_password(plain_password, hashed_password)[source]¶

Verify a password against its hash.

Parameters:

  • plain_password (str) – Plain text password to verify.

  • hashed_password (str) – Stored hashed password.

Return type:

bool

Returns:

True if password matches, False otherwise.

Projects¶

Projects router module.

Provides API endpoints for project CRUD, likes, reviews, and analytics.

get_authenticated_user(token, db)[source]¶

Validate token and return authenticated user.

Parameters:

  • token (str) – JWT access token.

  • db (Session) – Database session.

Return type:

User

Returns:

Authenticated user object.

Raises:

HTTPException – If token is invalid or user not found.

create_project(project, token, db=fastapi.Depends)¶

Create a new project.

Parameters:

  • project (ProjectCreate) – Project data.

  • token (str) – JWT access token.

  • db (Session) – Database session.

Return type:

ProjectResponse

Returns:

Created project data.

get_projects(db=fastapi.Depends)¶

Get all projects with user info and stats.

Parameters:

db (Session) – Database session.

Return type:

List[ProjectWithUser]

Returns:

List of projects with owner username and counts.

get_my_projects(token, db=fastapi.Depends)¶

Get current user’s projects.

Parameters:

  • token (str) – JWT access token.

  • db (Session) – Database session.

Return type:

List[ProjectResponse]

Returns:

List of user’s projects.

get_project(project_id, db=fastapi.Depends)¶

Get a single project by ID.

Parameters:

  • project_id (int) – Project ID.

  • db (Session) – Database session.

Return type:

ProjectWithUser

Returns:

Project data with owner and stats.

Raises:

HTTPException – If project not found.

like_project(project_id, token, db=fastapi.Depends)¶

Like a project.

Parameters:

  • project_id (int) – Project ID to like.

  • token (str) – JWT access token.

  • db (Session) – Database session.

Return type:

LikeResponse

Returns:

Created like data.

Raises:

HTTPException – If already liked or project not found.

unlike_project(project_id, token, db=fastapi.Depends)¶

Remove like from a project.

Parameters:

  • project_id (int) – Project ID to unlike.

  • token (str) – JWT access token.

  • db (Session) – Database session.

Return type:

dict

Returns:

Success message.

Raises:

HTTPException – If like not found.

check_liked(project_id, token, db=fastapi.Depends)¶

Check if current user liked a project.

Parameters:

  • project_id (int) – Project ID.

  • token (str) – JWT access token.

  • db (Session) – Database session.

Return type:

bool

Returns:

True if liked, False otherwise.

Create a review for a project.

Parameters:

Return type:

ReviewResponse

Returns:

Created review data.

Raises:

HTTPException – If already reviewed or project not found.

List[ReviewResponse]

List of reviews.
